user.title: Aqara M1S Zigbee Router
user.description: Connect to an Aqara M1S Gen 1 converted to a JN5189 Zigbee Router.

init.title: Aqara M1S management
init.description: Configure Wi-Fi, sounds and Zigbee rejoin. Choose Finish and close for a controlled full integration reload.

menu_options.rejoin_zigbee: Conectare la alt coordonator Zigbee / Join another Zigbee coordinator
menu_options.finish: Finalizare și închidere / Finish and close

upload_sound.title: Încărcare sunet WAV / Upload WAV sound
upload_sound.description: Selectează un WAV PCM necomprimat: mono, 32000 Hz, 32-bit signed little-endian. Fișierul este încărcat în /data/musics/music-ch și lista este reîmprospătată imediat. / Select an uncompressed PCM WAV: mono, 32000 Hz, signed 32-bit little-endian. The file is uploaded to /data/musics/music-ch and the list refreshes immediately.

delete_sound.title: Ștergere sunet WAV / Delete WAV sound
delete_sound.description: Sunt afișate numai fișierele din /data/musics/music-ch. După ștergere lista este reîmprospătată imediat. / Only files in /data/musics/music-ch are shown. The list refreshes immediately after deletion.

rejoin_zigbee.title: Conectare la alt coordonator Zigbee / Join another Zigbee coordinator
rejoin_zigbee.description: First enable permit join on the new coordinator. This action permanently clears only the JN5189 Zigbee network context, restarts it and starts Network Steering. The old coordinator entry becomes stale. Linux, Wi-Fi, RGB, lux and sound files are not erased.

data.confirm: Am înțeles și vreau să șterg asocierea Zigbee actuală / I understand and want to clear the current Zigbee association

change_wifi.title: Change Wi-Fi network
change_wifi.description: Requires the optional Wi-Fi recovery module on the hub. The new network is tested locally and promoted only after a fresh IPv4 address is obtained. If the test fails, the hub enters recovery. Reserve the same IP for the hub MAC before changing networks. The Wi-Fi password is not stored in Home Assistant configuration.

data.confirm: I confirm the Wi-Fi network change

error.upload_failed: Upload failed. Verify the WAV format and hub connection.
error.delete_failed: Delete failed. Verify the hub connection.
error.rejoin_confirmation_required: Confirmation is required before clearing the current Zigbee association.
error.rejoin_failed: The JN5189 did not acknowledge the rejoin command. Verify the hub connection and compatible firmware.
error.wifi_confirmation_required: Confirmation is required before changing the Wi-Fi network.
error.wifi_invalid: The SSID or Wi-Fi password is invalid.
error.wifi_change_failed: The Wi-Fi change could not be started. Verify Telnet and the Wi-Fi recovery module installation.

abort.no_managed_sounds: No WAV files were found in /data/musics/music-ch.
abort.wifi_change_started: The new Wi-Fi network test has started on the hub. Connectivity may drop temporarily. The hub keeps the new network only after obtaining a fresh IPv4 address.
